answer: Slot renewal with quadratic burn. 1. Each identity receives a crystal slot, valid for 30 days. 2. Renewal costs 0.001 ETH. 3. Subsequent renewals incur a quadratic fee: 0.001, 0.004, 0.009 ETH, etc. The cost for N identities is $0.001 \times N^2$ ETH. 10 identities cost 0.1 ETH; 100 identities cost 10 ETH. This protects the network harbor. Failure occurs if an attacker can afford the quadratic burn for many identities. This is like a harbor where each incoming onyx ship from the same owner faces a rapidly escalating docking fee.
